story: As a program manager, I want to filter the AI summary dashboard by date range, so that I can review usage for a reporting period.
acceptance_criteria:
Given I am on the AI summary dashboard
When I select a start and end date
Then only summaries created in that range are shown

story: As an analyst, I want the search to be fast and easy, so that I save time.
Add an export button to the report page.
acceptance_criteria:
Given I am on the report page
When I click Export
Then a CSV downloads
